question: Does any retrieved work train a model on supervision examples that contain multiple co-occurring/co-passage triples (rather than a single triple, a path, or an inference-time retrieved subgraph), which would directly pre-empt the idea's central mechanism?
description: Retrieved subgraph works (DrKGC, GNN-RAG, GRAG, SG-RAG MOT, UniKGQA) retrieve context at inference or fine-tune with a retrieved subgraph prompt. The distinguishing feature of the idea is that the context is attached to each *training supervision signal* and derived from the *source passage*. No retrieved paper was found that both (a) trains on multiple co-occurring triples per example and (b) uses passage provenance to select them; this needs a targeted search and comparison.
rationale: This determines whether the context-enriched-supervision component is genuinely uncovered or an incremental re-description of subgraph-conditioned fine-tuning (DrKGC).
